title: Senior Data Scientist, Workforce Management Analytics
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the Support Group

As the name Support Group implies, this group is responsible for the core part of the customer experience journey that has got Wolt top-notch ratings in app stores. 

During the years we’ve invested a lot in the in-house built support tooling as we believe that it’s the only way we can ensure the satisfaction of all of our customers and partners in each of the 25 countries that we operate in. We take huge pride in our customer operations’ quality, so on top of building delightful support experiences in our consumer app we also want to proactively identify and solve issues even before our customers and partners even notice something might be wrong.

About the Support Analytics Team

Our Support Analytics team’s main goal is to deliver an amazing Customer, Merchants & Courier support experience while optimizing our operations by providing actionable insights and quantifying the impact of those actions on the overall business. 💡 

You’ll be part of this team working with top Data Science and Analytics Engineering professionals.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Data Scientist at Wolt, your role involves diving into our data to solve crucial business problems. The scope of this role ranges from diagnosing problem areas to identifying solutions to designing experiments and ultimately influencing decision-making. This is a rare, operational, and actionable data-driven experience. When you join this team, you will be driving action from the frontlines, rather than just doing yet another analytics role.

Your job will mainly focus on driving operational efficiency with the  Workforce Management (WFM) team and optimizing resource allocation by creating accurate scheduling and intraday forecasts, simplifying forecasting processes, building and supporting KPI dashboards, conducting root cause analysis for SLA improvements, exploring cost optimization opportunities, managing the capacity plan framework, enhancing the WFM data pipeline, and uncovering data-driven insights to refine planning, scheduling, reporting, and intraday management.

Our humble expectations

Required:

• 5+ years of experience in a data science or analytics position

• Experience building forecasting models and time series analysis (Prophet, SARIMA, Holt-Winters or similar)

• Experience in Cost Analysis and What-if Scenario Analysis

• Deep knowledge of statistical packages in Python or R

• Proficiency in writing structured and efficient SQL queries for large data sets

• Ability to influence and advise senior stakeholders Good to have:

• Experience using ML for forecasting

• Experience working with ML engineers/ML platform

• Building data pipelines using Airflow or similar tools

What we offer

• The online delivery platform that Wolt is building will offer you interesting and complex challenges, together with the opportunities to create a big impact with your skills. Lots of geolocational and temporal data in real-time, combined with differences in the economics and dynamics of the cities we operate in, make Wolt both a challenging and interesting company to practice analytics.

• You have the chance to decide the ways of working: a hybrid, at the office, or remote in Berlin. 💙

title: Software Engineer, Applied AI
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

title: Staff / Senior Staff Security Engineer, Vinted Go
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As Staff / Senior Staff Security Engineer in Vinted Go, you will be the first dedicated security engineer inside our logistics business - and the person who makes Vinted Go's security posture match its growth. Vinted Go is a rare security problem in the best sense: a European-scale logistics network where software, physical infrastructure, and dozens of external partners meet. Its attack surface spans shipping services and carrier APIs, a locker and PUDO network in public space, sorting facilities with real operational technology, driver and warehouse applications, and hardware and engineering partners.

Working at staff / senior staff level as an individual contributor embedded in Vinted Go engineering, you will own the security of that whole estate. Vinted Security runs a federated model: the central team sets thresholds and provides core services, while each business unit owns local execution. Vinted Go's local execution is what you will build - this is not a policy or audit role, it is an engineering role with a mandate. You will work directly with Vinted Go's engineering leadership and functionally with the Vinted Security senior team and your security peers in Marketplace and Vinted Pay.

This is a build role with room to grow: you start hands-on, closing the highest-impact gaps yourself, and as the function matures you will stand up and functionally lead a Vinted Go Security Ops capability.

In this position, you’ll 

• Own the Vinted Go security roadmap end to end: assess the estate, prioritise by real attack paths, and drive risks to closure - with the explicit goal of keeping Vinted Go's resilience to external attack ahead of its growth and at the standard Vinted holds itself to.

• Secure a physical-digital surface few companies have: carrier integrations, locker and PUDO hardware, sorting-facility operational technology (conveyors, robotics, cameras), driver and warehouse applications, and electronics verification related software and hardware.

• Stand up Vinted Go's Security Ops capability - detection, response, and vulnerability management for Vinted Go-specific systems - building on central platforms rather than duplicating them.

• Embed secure development into Vinted Go engineering, including external engineering partners, so security lands at design time rather than after deployment.

• Own third-party security across the network: 40+ carriers, hardware vendors, and outsourced engineering - set the requirements, verify them, and manage the residual risk

title: Senior Broadband Network Engineer
description:
IQ Fiber was built to do internet differently. We're a 100% fiber-optic internet provider with a simple mission: To engineer a smarter internet experience. That means internet that's fast, reliable, and simply priced, backed by real humans who answer when you call and solve problems before you know they exist.
We bring that same thinking to how we build our company. Our teammates are a big part of what makes IQ Fiber different, and we believe how we work matters just as much as what we deliver. We're looking for good humans who bring great ideas, raise the bar with every task, and want to be part of a bigger story. Your work matters here.
Position Summary
IQ Fiber is seeking a Senior Broadband Network Engineer to serve as a highly skilled, hands-on technical expert responsible for designing, optimizing, and supporting IQ Fiber 's core and access broadband networks. This role plays a critical part in delivering reliable, scalable, and high-performance FTTP services by leading complex engineering initiatives and serving as a subject matter expert across network technologies.
The Senior Broadband Network Engineer takes ownership of advanced network design, configuration, and troubleshooting across core routing, access networks, and transport systems, working closely with Network Engineering, NOC, and Outside Plant teams. As a senior team member, this role mentors junior engineers, drives best practices, and contributes to the development of standards, MOPs, and operational frameworks. This role also requires participation in an on-call rotation and after-hours support.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Lead the design, implementation, and optimization of core and access broadband networks, including FTTP (GPON/XGS-PON) environments

• Serve as a subject matter expert for routing and switching technologies, including BGP, MPLS, VLANs, VPNs, and high-availability protocols (VRRP, ERPS)

• Configure, manage, and troubleshoot carrier-grade platforms, including Juniper MX/QFX and Nokia 7750 Service Routers

• Drive network performance improvements through proactive monitoring, data analysis, and capacity planning initiatives

title: Staff Frontend Engineer - Mapping & Spatial Platform
description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

About the Role

We are looking for a founding Staff Engineer to lead the technical architecture of our next-generation Spatial Platform. For the past decade, floor plans have been static images; we are rebuilding that foundation from the ground up as a high-performance, interactive, and collaborative 3D engine.

This is a greenfield role for a builder who wants to own a core pillar of Verkada’s infrastructure before we hit the public markets. You won't just build features-you will architect a platform that supports 8+ product lines, solving the "hard math" of geospatial projections and the "hard graphics" of rendering thousands of interactive assets at a buttery-smooth 60 FPS.

What You'll Do

• Build the Rendering Platform: Design a high-performance rendering architecture that supports both an interactive viewer for high-density geospatial visualization and a precision editing surface for real-time vertex manipulation.

• Set the UX Bar: Partner with Design to define the interaction model for spatial editing - easing curves, snapping behavior, cursor states, loading transitions - and hold the line on pixel-level polish across the platform.

• Optimize for Latency: Solve the "500-element wall" with partial GPU buffer updates and custom shaders, ensuring sub-millisecond input latency during real-time vertex manipulation.

• Spatial Intelligence: Develop power-user tools like real-time 3D line-of-sight analysis, signal strength heatmaps, and AI-driven hardware placement suggestions.

• Build the Sync Engine: Own the client-side CRDT architecture (Yjs/Automerge-class) powering offline-first, multi-user editing - document model, local persistence, presence, and conflict resolution.

What You Bring

• 5+ years of experience building complex, customer-facing web applications or high-performance graphics engines.

• Mastery of Web Technologies: JavaScript fundamentals (scoping, closures, contexts, prototypes, classes, etc.) and React expertise (common state and data libraries like React Query, Zustand, etc.)

• CS Fundamentals: A degree in Computer Science or a related field, with strong intuition for data structures, memory management, and linear algebra.

• Eye for Detail: Pixel-perfect execution - you notice the half-pixel misalignment, the 16ms jank, the easing curve that feels "off." You hold a high bar for visual polish and won't ship until interactions feel  right.

• Product Grit: Ability to bridge the gap between CAD-level precision and consumer-grade UX, partnering closely with Design to turn rough specs into delightful, production-grade experiences.

• Mathematical Precision: Understanding of coordinate system conversions, geospatial projections, and 3D geometry.

Nice to Haves

• Graphics Stack: Experience with Deck.gl, MapLibre, Three.js, or raw WebGL/WebGPU.

• Collaborative Systems: Experien

title: Chef de projet – Mise à jour SAP S/4HANA
description:
Lieu : Montréal - télétravail possible depuis le Québec ou l’Ontario
Durée : Jusqu’au 31 janvier 2027, renouvelable

Heures : 35 h/semaine

Langue : Anglais requis - profil bilingue accepté

À propos du poste

Nous recherchons un Chef de projet SAP S/4HANA senior pour piloter un projet de mise à niveau de la plateforme SAP S/4HANA vers une version plus récente. La personne sera responsable de la planification, de la coordination et de l’exécution complète de l’upgrade, de la préparation initiale jusqu’à la mise en production et à la stabilisation post-déploiement.

Le mandat évolue dans une grande organisation de plus de 10 000 employés, au sein d’un environnement complexe et fortement réglementé. Le Chef de projet travaillera avec plusieurs équipes internes et externes, notamment SAP, BASIS, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, équipes d’affaires, partenaires et fournisseurs.

Exigences principales

• 10+ années d’expérience en gestion de projets SAP.

• Expérience concrète dans la gestion de mises à niveau SAP S/4HANA, idéalement d’une version 2020/2021 vers 2023 ou plus récente.

• Excellente maîtrise de la méthodologie SAP Activate.

• Expérience importante dans les domaines Supply Chain et Manufacturing.

• Expérience dans une organisation de plus de 10 000 employés.

• Expérience de projets SAP globaux impliquant plusieurs équipes, fournisseurs et parties prenantes.

• Expérience en environnement hautement réglementé.

• Capacité à coordonner plusieurs fournisseurs et partenaires simultanément.

• Expérience importante dans la planification et le pilotage des tests, cutover et mises en production.

• Excellente maîtrise de la gouvernance de projet, notamment échéanciers, budgets, jalons, dépendances et registres RAID.

• Capacité à communiquer efficacement avec les équipes techniques, les responsables d’affaires et la haute direction.

Atouts

Une expérience en custom code remediation lors d’un upgrade S/4HANA est particulièrement pertinente. Une bonne compréhension de SAP BASIS et de l’architecture SAP, ainsi qu’une expérience de tests à grande échelle et de périodes d’hypercare/stabilisation post-go-live, constituent également des atouts.

Les certifications PMP, PRINCE2 ou SAP sont appréciées.

Responsabilités principales

Le Chef de projet prendra en charge le plan détaillé de la mise à niveau SAP, incluant les échéanciers, ressources, jalons, risques, enjeux et dépendances. Il pilotera les différentes phases du projet selon SAP Activate, notamment la préparation, le Sandbox, le développement, l’assurance qualité, les tests et la mise en production.

Il coordonnera les campagnes de tests intégrés, de régression et de performance, ainsi que la stratégie et l’exécution du cutover. Il sera également responsable de la coordination entre les équipes SAP/BASIS, les responsables des processus d’affaires, les équipes Supply Chain et Manufacturing ainsi que les différents fournisseurs.

La personne assurera la gouvernance du projet, le contrôle des changements, le suivi des risques et la production des rapports destinés à la haute direction. Elle contribuera également à la gestion du changement, à la formation, à la documentation et à la période de stabilisation suivant la mise en production.

Vos informations seront traitées de manière confidentielle et conformément à la Loi 25 sur la protection des renseignements personnels du Québec. title: Sales Representative (m/w/d) Quereinstieg - Solothurn
description:
Du hast noch nie im B2B-Vertrieb gearbeitet, möchtest aber gerne alle wichtigen Werkzeuge erlernen, um so richtig durchzustarten? Bei Salonkee lernst du den Vertrieb von Grund auf kennen und baust dir in Solothurn dein eigenes Netzwerk auf.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70 % weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

DEINE ROLLE

- Du verantwortest das Wachstum in deiner Region und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson vor Ort

- Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu - telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

- Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

- Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

- Deine Woche planst du eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Vertriebserfahrung ist nicht unbedingt notwendig. Wenn du aus dem Hospitality, Beauty, Retail, Fitness, Event oder einem anderen Bereich mit viel Kundenkontakt kommst, bringst du das Wichtigste schon mit.

- Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch - egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort.

- Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken.

- Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist strukturiert, organisiert und sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Vertrieb von Grund auf lernen: Bootcamp zum Start, gezieltes Ramp-Up Programm, Shadowing bei erfahrenen Kolleg:innen, Roleplays und regelmäßiges Coaching.

- Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region - du startest nicht allein.

- Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad: von Junior über Senior bis hin zu Führungsrollen.

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die ihren Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Teamformate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

title: Senior Account Executive
description:
Vividly is the leading modern trade promotion management (TPM) solution built by and for the consumer packaged goods industry. From campaign creation to deductions management and promotion measurement, we help brands manage every element of trade spend. With our easy-to-use platform and industry-leading experience, we pride ourselves on our ability to bring businesses to the next level.
Not familiar with trade promotion spend? That’s OK. Most people aren’t. It’s an $8 trillion dollar problem that is ripe for disruption by an innovative SaaS startup. In order to grow, consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands spend 20% of their topline revenue to get into retailers and promote their products within those retailers. The problem is that today 70% of those promotions are not ROI positive. This is because ROI is hard to track. The industry operates on emails, pdfs, and xls spreadsheets. At Vividly , we’re solving this massive problem with exciting tactics including AI, Machine Learning, and Fintech and adding value to everyone in the chain. Some of our customers include brands you may use and love - Liquid Death, Amy’s, and Perfect Snacks.
The Opportunity
We’re looking for an Account Executive who brings both SaaS sales expertise and a deep understanding of the CPG ecosystem . This is a unique opportunity to operate at the intersection of technology, finance, and commercial strategy - selling a high-impact solution into organizations where trade spend directly influences revenue, margin, and growth. You will own the full sales cycle, lead complex, multi-stakeholder deals, and partner with senior leaders across Sales, Finance, and Operations to drive meaningful business outcomes.
What You’ll Do

• Own the full sales cycle - from prospecting through close - focused on acquiring new CPG customers

• Build and manage a pipeline through outbound prospecting, self-sourcing, and collaboration with SDR and Marketing teams

• Lead consultative discovery to uncover inefficiencies in trade spend, promotions, and revenue execution

• Translate customer challenges into quantified business value (e.g., ROI improvement, margin expansion, revenue lift)

• Navigate and align cross-functional buying groups , including Sales, Finance, Revenue Management, and Operations

• Drive complex, multi-threaded deals with multiple stakeholders and decision-makers

• Deliver tailored, value-based presentations that clearly articulate Vividly ’s impact

• Partner cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, and Customer Success to ensure long-term customer value

• Consistently exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets through disciplined pipeline management

Who You Are
You are a consultative, value-driven seller who thrives in complex environments and understands how large organizations make decisions.
You bring a strong grasp of how CPG businesses operate and can confidently engage stakeholders across both commercial and financial functions. You are equally comfortable discussing margin impact with Finance as you are with execution challenges with Sales teams .
You are resourceful, proactive, and motivated by solving real business problems - not just closing deals.
What We’re Looking For
Required

• 5+ years of quota-carrying experience in SaaS sales, with a track record of closing complex, multi-threaded deals

•
Experience working in or selling into the CPG industry (brand, broker, retailer, or distributor ecosystem)

• Proven ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders , including Director, VP, and C-level executives

• Strong experience with consultative sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDIC, Challenger, SPIN, Sandler, or similar)

• Demonstrated success in outbound prospecting and building pipeline independently

• Excellent communication, presentation, and storytelling skills

Highly Preferred

• Experience with trade promotion, revenue management, retail execution, or deductions workflows

• Background selling data, analytics, or financial SaaS solutio

Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. title: Kondor+ Integration, Data & Database Consultant
description:
CAPCO POLAND 

*We are looking for Poland based candidate. 

At  Capco Poland, we’re not just another consultancy - we’re the spark behind digital transformation in the financial world. As a global leader in technology and management consulting, we thrive on helping clients tackle the toughest challenges across banking, payments, capital markets, wealth, and asset management.

Role Purpose

The Kondor+ Integration, Data & Database Consultant will be responsible for the integration, data migration and database-related activities required as part of the Kondor+ / Fusion Kondor upgrade .

The role will analyse the existing Kondor+ integration and data landscape, assess impacts introduced by the target Kondor+ release, implement or coordinate required interface changes, support database upgrade/migration activities, and ensure the completeness and integrity of data throughout the upgrade.

The consultant will work closely with the Kondor+ Solution Architect, Technical Consultants, Functional Consultants, client DBA/infrastructure teams and downstream application owners.

Key Responsibilities

Kondor+ Integration

• Analyse the existing Kondor+ integration landscape , covering inbound and outbound interfaces.

• Assess the impact of the Kondor+ upgrade on existing interfaces, APIs, message structures, file exchanges and integration components.

• Design and implement or coordinate required modifications to Kondor+ interfaces.

• Support integration between Kondor+ and surrounding systems such as:

• Market data providers

• Electronic trading platforms

• Payment and settlement systems

• SWIFT/messaging platforms

• Core banking systems

• General Ledger and accounting platforms

• Risk and regulatory systems

• Data warehouses and reporting platforms

• Analyse and troubleshoot failed Kondor+ interfaces and data-processing issues.

• Validate end-to-end STP flows through Kondor+ and downstream applications.

• Support API, messaging, middleware and file-based integrations used by Kondor+.

• Support interface reconciliation during SIT, UAT, migration rehearsals and production cutover.

Kondor+ Data Migration & Reconciliation

• Analyse the Kondor+ data landscape and identify data impacted by the upgrade.

• Define the data migration/conversion approach together with the Kondor+ Solution Architect and functional SMEs.

• Support migration or conversion of Kondor+ static/reference and transactional data where required.

• Analyse and validate Kondor+ data structures and dependencies.

• Develop SQL queries and reconciliation controls to validate migrated/upgraded data.

• Reconcile relevant data between source and target Kondor+ environments, including:

• Trades and transactions

• Static/reference data

• Positions

• Cashflows

• Market data where applicable

• Valuations

• Accounting balances/postings

• Interface data

• Investigate and resolve data discrepancies between existing and upgraded Kondor+ environments.

• Support migration dry runs and cutover rehearsals.

• Define data validation and reconciliation criteria for production migration.

• Support post-go-live data reconciliation and hypercare.

Kondor+ Database

• Analyse the existing Kondor+ database environment and dependencies .

• Support database-related prerequisites for the Kondor+ target release.

• Support execution and validation of Kondor+ database upgrade/conversion scripts.

• Analyse Kondor+ database schemas, tables and data relationships as required for troubleshooting, integration and reconciliation.

• Develop SQL scripts and queries supporting migration, testing and reconciliation.

• Support database backup, restore and rollback activities in collaboration with the client's DBA team.

• Identify database-related performance issues affecting Kondor+ processing.

• Support performance analysis of critical Kondor+ processes, including batch and EOD processing.

• Coordinate with client DBAs on database configuration, capacity,

title: A.I. Research Engineer

QOVES is a biomedical startup that focuses on improving patient experiences in cosmetic medical clinics through software. In simple speak, we make software that uses A.I., computer vision, recommendation algorithms and other to predict how patients may look like after cosmetic surgery and to diagnose whether the surgery is even beneficial. Our goal is to turn the process of consultation for cosmetic surgery into a well defined, clinical procedure of diagnosis and visualisation through our software integrations with clinics.
Your Role
In simple terms, you will be in charge of managing the technical development of the product directly under the CTO for A.I. related matters. This involves conducting research into the latest papers and approaches into visualization and generative networks, finetuneing existing products and deploying endpoints to production to work with the rest of the team.
Position: Research A.I. Engineer
Location: Remote / London (preferred), sponsorship possible
Employment Type: Full-timeOur

• Curious, intellectual, confident - Team members that are confident in their decisions; a self-assured confidence that comes from years of experience and independent research. You're able to call out wrong decisions and stand behind your own with conviction.

• Work hard, play hard we often have to work 60+ hour weeks and expect the same from our team. When it needs to be done, we do it but in return we recognise and reward team players for their dedication to the craft.

• Meritocracy, always you own and earn your destiny. The best argument wins, not the loudest voice or the most senior team member.

Why Work at QOVES

• We're solving a real problem with real implications - the healthcare system is overworked, A.I. integration will help dramatically ease the triage burden.

• We have the resources to achieve our mission. We have raised a sizable seed round backed by local and foreign investors to fund our product development.

• We are developing cutting-edge AI technology. The systems being built rely on our latest internal and external research in generative and computer vision fields to accurately diagnose medical anomalies from photographs of patients. Succeeding here will provide you a strong backing into future companies leveraging these A.I. discoveries to build newer products.

• We have an endless supply of customers and interest. With our social platforms getting 40 million+ unique viewers a month, the top celebrity doctors on our waitlists and endless celebrities as our current customers, we've built enough influence in our field over 4 years to be the largest in solving the facial diagnostic problem. We have the head start to reach the multiple billions.

• Work with two established founders to solve a generational problem.

Your Role to Shape QOVES
At QOVES as a Founding AI Engineer, you will help build the most advanced AI facial diagnostic pipeline in the world. It's no easy task but you won't be alone!
Your qualifications
You have demonstrated the ability to build world-class AI/LLM applications, with a strong emphasis on building visualisation systems (GANs, Diffusion Models...):

• 3+ years of work experience deploying LLM/ML models to production

• Technical experience with visual generative models, especially in Generative Adversarial Networks.

• Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI, Math, Physics, or similar or equivalent additional work experience

• Excellent communication skills to interact with founding team and customers

• Ability to understand and implement technical state-of-the-art research papers

• Proficiency to write production-level code for AI/LLM based applications

title: Senior Manager, GTM Talent Acquisition - North America

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

- We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

- We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

- We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

THE ROLE

Legora recently passed $200M in ARR, doubling in less than six months. North America is our fastest-growing market, our largest, and the one where competition is fiercest. We're hiring at significant scale across the teams that sell, deploy and grow Legora, from our New York, San Francisco, Chicago, Denver, Houston, Toronto and Mexico City offices. - Hold the standard for candidate experience across your team, from first conversation through to offer. Every interaction should reflect the quality of the product and the people behind it.

- Partner with the Senior Director of Global GTM Talent Acquisition and your European counterpart on process consistency and shared standards as both regions scale.

title: Critical Facilities Engineer - Memphis/Southaven
description:
SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge.  Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Sr. Facilities Operations Technician at SpaceXAI, you'll dive in, operating and maintaining the critical facility systems that power our supercomputing data centers. Working hands-on with MEP systems, you’ll tackle maintenance, operations, and repairs, ensuring peak performance and reliability. Expect to troubleshoot complex issues, streamline processes, and collaborate with teams to keep our infrastructure running smoothly, directly supporting xAI’s mission to accelerate human scientific discovery through AI. 

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Independently operate and maintain critical mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems in supercomputing data centers, ensuring high reliability and performance through hands-on maintenance, troubleshooting, and process optimization.

• Perform advanced maintenance and troubleshooting of critical data center systems like HVAC, power, and environmental controls, while mentoring junior technicians to ensure operational reliability.

• Oversee the maintenance and optimization of critical data center infrastructure, including power, cooling, and environmental systems, while leading a team of technicians to ensure operational reliability and efficiency.

• Responsible for MEP Infrastructure site safety and environmental compliance, ensuring the sites align with all local and regional health and safety requirements.

• Routinely inspect all areas to ensure performance measures are being maintained and proactively self-report the problems of facilities.

• Experience with writing and executing MOPs, SOPs, EOPs.

• Perform daily inspections of critical systems.

• Identify and maintain spare parts inventory to minimize downtime.

• Coordinate and supervise scheduled system shutdowns.

• Develop and implement energy monitoring metrics.

• Support commissioning efforts by witnessing equipment startup, assisting with functional testing, and monitoring construction progress.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical or Electrical or 6+ years of hands-on operations/facilities work experience in lieu of degree (data center experience preferred).

• Knowledge of mechanical or electrical engineering principles and systems (both would be a huge plus).

• Experience and knowledge of all critical systems documentation including Plans, Procedures, and Operations Manuals.

• Experience and knowledge of Building and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems and Operations.

• Strong troubleshooting skills.

• Experience with PLC-based control systems and/or with Building Management Systems (Client).

• Excellent written and verbal communication and technical writing skills in English.

• Physical Requirements:

• Ability to lift up to 50 lbs.

• Ability to utilize hand tools and power tools as needed.

• Work is often performed in tight quarters, and physical dexterity is necessary to perform job functions.

• Ability to lift up to 35 lbs. unassiste

title: Legal Operations Lead
description:
ABOUT US:

AI needs a new infrastructure layer. We're building it at Modal.

Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now.

Our customers include category-defining companies like Ramp https://modal.com/blog/how-ramp-built-a-full-context-background-coding-agent-on-modal, Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale.

We recently raised a $355M Series C https://modal.com/blog/modal-series-c at a $4.65B valuation, led by General Catalyst and Redpoint Ventures. We've crossed $300M+ ARR and grown fivefold since September.

Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g.,Seaborn https://github.com/mwaskom/seaborn,Luigi https://github.com/spotify/luigi), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience.

THE ROLE:

We're looking for a Legal Operations Lead to join us as the first dedicated legal operations hire at Modal. You'll own the systems, records, and workflows that let a small legal team keep pace with a high-growth tech company - and you'll have an opportunity to build most of them from scratch.

This is a great fit for a highly organized, systems-oriented operator who thrives in a fast-paced environment and wants to build operational foundations, not just maintain them. You'll report to our General Counsel and collaborate closely with the Finance, BizOps, GTM, and People teams.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Build and maintain contract operations, including designing the contract lifecycle management workflows and approval logic, and continuing to iterate and improve those processes

- Design legal intake process to support and route legal requests from internal stakeholders

- Make the legal function faster with AI and build and configure tooling to make us more efficient

- Manage corporate administration and record-keeping, including Board and stockholder matters, signature coordination, and building a knowledge management system and database

- Be the point person for corporate compliance, including entity management and filings, including foreign and domestic qualifications and filings and coordinate with registered agents

- Support stock administration and cap table hygiene

- Manage outside counsel and legal spend

REQUIREMENTS:

- 5+ years in legal operations, contract operations, or a corporate paralegal role, preferably at a high-growth technology company

- Demonstrated ability to build and document processes from the ground up, not just execute existing ones

- Experience configuring workflows and templates within Ironclad or a similar CLM

- Experience with AI tools, and good instincts about where they help and where they quietly introduce risk

- Sound judgment about what to handle and what to escalate

BONUS:

- Exposure to corporate and equity administration; familiarity with Carta or a similar equity administration platform

OPERATIONS & AUTOMATION ENGINEER - RENEWABLE SUPPLY

Festanstellung, Vollzeit · Berlin (HQ)

Gestalte mit uns die nachhaltige Energieversorgung von morgen - und baue als Operations & Automation Engineer skalierbare Prozesse und Automatisierungslösungen auf, die trawa beim Wachstum unterstützen. trawa baut Europas führende B2B-Plattform für saubere Energie. Wir kombinieren Energiebelieferung, fortschrittliche Energiemanagement-Software und intelligente Optimierung von Verbrauch und Flexibilitäten, damit Unternehmen in einem volatilen Energiemarkt erfolgreich bleiben und ihre Dekarbonisierung beschleunigen.

Als Operations & Automation Engineer startest du im Customer Support - nicht weil Support deine Endstation ist, sondern weil direkter Kundenkontakt der beste Weg ist, zu verstehen, wo Automatisierung den größten Unterschied macht. Du entwickelst unseren KI-gestützten Ticket-Copilot weiter, baust die dafür nötige Tooling-Landschaft auf und erweiterst deinen Wirkungskreis Schritt für Schritt auf den gesamten Ops-Bereich. Dein Ziel: manuelle und wiederkehrende Aufgaben zu reduzieren und trawa dadurch effizienter, schneller und skalierbarer zu machen.

Als Operations & Automation Engineer übernimmst du folgende Aufgaben:

- Weiterentwicklung des Customer Support-Agenten: Du bist Owner unseres KI-gestützten Ticket-Copilots - von der Anforderungsdefinition über die technische Weiterentwicklung bis zur Integration in unsere Tooling-Landschaft (Velaris, Airtable, HubSpot). Du treibst die Automatisierung von Ticket-Assignment, Lösungsvorschlägen und Kundenkommunikation aktiv voran.

- Customer Support als Lernvehikel: Du bearbeitest selbst eingehende Kundenanfragen - per Telefon und E-Mail - um ein tiefes Verständnis für wiederkehrende Probleme, Edge Cases und Prozesslücken zu entwickeln. Dieses Wissen fließt direkt in die Weiterentwicklung des Agenten und der Knowledge Base ein.

- Ownership der Tooling-Landschaft: Du evaluierst, implementierst und entwickelst die Tools weiter, die unser Ops-Team braucht - von dedizierten Ticketing-Systemen bis hin zu Automatisierungsplattformen. Du erkennst, wo aktuelle Tools an ihre Grenzen stoßen, und treibst die Einführung von Alternativen voran.

- Automatisierung im gesamten Ops-Bereich: Customer Support ist der Anfang. Gemeinsam mit angrenzenden Teams - Finance, Onboarding, Customer Success - identifizierst du weitere Automatisierungspotenziale, entwickelst Lösungen und hilfst so, Automatisierung bei trawa Schritt für Schritt weiter auszubauen.

- Stakeholder Management & kontinuierliche Iteration: Du arbeitest eng mit internen Teams zusammen, holst Feedback ein, priorisierst Anforderungen und sorgst dafür, dass Automatisierungslösungen nicht nur gebaut, sondern auch genutzt und stetig verbessert werden.

Das Team

title: Senior Clinical Trials Budget Analyst - Remote
description:
About Vitalief
Vitalief is a clinical research consulting firm focused exclusively on the clinical research industry, providing consulting, staffing, and technology-enabled services to academic medical centers, health systems, sponsors, CROs, and site networks. By combining deep subject matter expertise with the experience of senior research practitioners, we help organizations accelerate study activation, optimize operations, improve financial performance, and build scalable workforce solutions that reduce costs, increase efficiency, and advance clinical breakthroughs for patients.

The Role
As part of our growth, we are seeking a hands-on, detail-oriented, client-facing professional with deep clinical trial budgeting expertise to join Vitalief ’s Budgeting Outsourcing Services Team. This role is focused on directly supporting Academic Medical Centers (AMCs) and clinical research health systems with day-to-day budgeting, coverage analysis, and billing compliance activities.

Why Join Vitalief ?

•
Make an Impact: Support leading AMCs and health systems in improving clinical trial financial performance and compliance.

•
Innovation-Driven: Help modernize clinical trial budgeting and billing processes using technology and best practices.

•
People-First Culture: Thrive in an environment that fosters growth, innovation, and collaboration.

•
Comprehensive Benefits: Enjoy 20 PTO days, 9 paid holidays, company-paid life insurance, short- and long-term disability, a 401(k)-retirement plan, and robust healthcare options.

•
Flexible & Remote-Friendly: Primarily remote with occasional travel (up to 10%).

•
Salary Range: $75,000 to $125,000 - Based on experience level.

Responsibilities

• Develop, build, and finalize clinical trial budgets for industry-sponsored studies (oncology and non-oncology) in collaboration with academic medical center (AMC) and health system stakeholders.

• Perform detailed Medicare Coverage Analyses (MCA) to accurately distinguish routine care from research-related costs in compliance with CMS guidelines.

• Configure and maintain study calendars, budgets, and billing grids within OnCore, ensuring alignment with protocol requirements and institutional billing practices.

• Support clinical trial start-up by ensuring accurate budget setup, billing designations, and downstream readiness for compliant invoicing and revenue capture.

• Lead or support budget negotiations with sponsors and CROs, advocating for fair market value and full cost recovery for AMCs and health systems.

• Partner closely with investigators, study coordinators, finance, and revenue cycle teams to validate assumptions and resolve budget or billing discrepancies.

• Conduct ongoing budget tracking, reconciliation, and variance analysis to ensure financial accuracy throughout the study lifecycle.

• Identify and mitigate billing compliance risks while ensuring adherence to CMS, FDA, NIH, and institutional policies.

• Standardize and improve budgeting and Medicare Coverage Analysis workflows, templates, and tools to increase efficiency and consistency across client engagements.

• Provide hands-on support across multiple client engagements, effectively managing competing priorities while delivering high-quality results.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree required; Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.

• 3 to 5+ years of hands-on experience in clinical trial budgeting within an academic medical center or health system.

• Strong expertise in Medicare Coverage Analysis (MCA) and clinical trial billing compliance.

• Experience using a Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) to build study calendars, budgets, and billing grids; OnCore experience is strongly preferred.

• Proven experience negotiating clinical trial budgets with sponsors and CROs.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills with proficiency in Microsoft Excel.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

title: IT Consultant (m/w/d)
description:
was dich erwartet
Die Univention GmbH steht für digitale Souveränität, offene IT-Infrastrukturen und Open-Source-basierte Softwarelösungen. Unser Ziel ist es, Organisationen - insbesondere aus öffentlicher Verwaltung und Bildung - sichere, unabhängige und gestaltbare IT-Umgebungen zu ermöglichen.

Mit unserem Identity & Access Management (IAM) und unserer modularen Open-Source-Lösung Nubus schaffen wir flexible, interoperable und souveräne IT-Infrastrukturen, die den Anforderungen moderner Verwaltungen und Bildungslandschaften gerecht werden.

• Komplexe Projekte technisch führen: Du übernimmst die technische Führung in Kundenprojekten und stellst mit deiner Erfahrung sicher, dass unsere Lösungen auch in anspruchsvollen IT-Umgebungen erfolgreich umgesetzt werden.

• Produkte weiterentwickeln: Du bringst Erkenntnisse aus Projekten strukturiert in Produktmanagement und Entwicklung ein.

was du mitbringst

• Erfahrung in Kundenprojekten: Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung in technisch komplexen Kundenprojekten - idealerweise als Consultant, Technical Lead, System Engineer oder Solution Architect.

• Zuhören & Verstehen: Du kannst sehr gut zuhören, stellst die richtigen Fragen und erkennst, was Kunden wirklich brauchen - auch über die ursprüngliche Anfrage hinaus.

• Linux-Expertise: Du bist sicher in der Administration von Linux-Servern.

• Breites technisches Fundament: Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in Netzwerken, DNS, Active Directory, LDAP, Containerisierung (Docker), APIs und Single Sign-on mit.

• IAM-Verständnis: Du hast ein konzeptionelles Verständnis von Identity & Access Management, User Lifecycle, Authentifizierung und Autorisierung (z. B. SAML, OIDC, OAuth, Kerberos).

Nice to have

• Kubernetes-Know-how: Erfahrung mit Kubernetes ist hilfreich, aber kein Muss - wir unterstützen dich beim Einstieg, wenn du ein solides Linux- und Infrastrukturverständnis mitbringst.

• IAM-Praxis: Du hast bereits mit Lösungen wie Keycloak, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) oder ADFS gearbeitet.

• CI/CD & Tools: Du kennst dich mit Git und CI/CD-Tools (z. B. GitLab CI) aus.

• Presales-Erfahrung: Du hast Erfahrung in Aufwandsschätzungen und Angebotsprozessen.

• Branchenerfahrung: Du kennst die Anforderungen im öffentlichen Sektor oder im Bildungsbereich.

Wir wissen, dass niemand alles kann. Für uns stehen deine Beratungserfahrung und ein tiefes Linux- und Infrastrukturverständnis im Vordergrund. At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Accounts Receivable Manager is a finance operations leader who will own Harvey's collections process and drive cash flow performance across a rapidly scaling global customer base. This role sits within the Finance team, whose mission is to build the operational backbone that supports Harvey's accelerating revenue growth and international expansion. By establishing a repeatable, scalable collections framework and closely monitoring DSO, this person ensures that Harvey maintains healthy cash conversion as deal volume and contract complexity increase. They will partner directly with Revenue Accounting, Deal Operations, Customer Success, and Legal to align the end-to-end order-to-cash cycle. It is a rare opportunity to build a critical financial function from the ground up at one of the most ambitious AI companies in the market.

- Monitor, analyze, and report on DSO, aging, and other AR performance metrics, driving continuous improvement in cash collection timelines.

- Partner cross-functionally with Revenue Accounting, Deal Operations, Legal, and Customer Success to resolve billing discrepancies and ensure accurate, timely invoicing.

- Develop AR policies, procedures, and internal controls to support audit readiness and compliance with local and international accounting standards.

- Manage and optimize billing systems and tools (e.g., NetSuite) to improve accuracy and efficiency across the order-to-cash cycle.

WHAT YOU HAVE

- 5+ years of progressive experience in accounts receivable, billing, or order-to-cash management, ideally in a high-growth SaaS or technology environment.

- Strong working knowledge of collections best practices, credit management, and cash application processes.

- Demonstrated experience building or significantly improving AR/collections processes and establishing scalable controls in a fast-paced organization.

- Proficiency with ERP systems (NetSuite strongly preferred), billing platforms, and Dunnings applications (Tesorio strongly preferred).

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across Finance, Sales, Legal, and Operations teams.

- Detail-oriented with strong analytical skills and a proactive, problem-solving mindset.

title: Product Designer
description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

Toast is building a unified, enterprise-grade inventory platform that will power inventory for every Toast location, Restaurants and Retail alike. We are seeking a highly skilled, AI-native Product Designer to shape that experience: someone with a strong portfolio, a focus on exceptional UI design, and the hands-on ability to build working prototypes with AI tools like Replit, Magic Patterns, or Claude. This role involves designing for the unique needs of a diverse customer base, including restaurants, hybrid models, convenience stores, bottle shops, grocery stores, and beyond.

You will be the product designer for inventory platform capabilities built by our Chennai teams, working day to day with a Chennai-based product manager counterpart and reporting to Toast Retail's design leadership in the U.S. Together you will turn product strategy into experiences customers can trust with their stock, their costs, and their books.

Why This Role Matters

Inventory is where a store's money sits. When stock counts are wrong, invoices are keyed in by hand, or costs don't reach the accounting system, owners lose margin and hours they don't have. The workflows you design will decide how supplier data, invoices, stock, costs, and revenue move through Toast and into our customers' accounting platforms, and whether the people doing that work, often at the end of a long shift, feel in control or buried in it.

You will be Toast Retail's design presence in our Chennai office: the on-site design partner for its product and engineering teams, and part of Toast's wider design community, including product designers in Bangalore. Because this work spans regions and time zones, the role calls for strong autonomous design judgment: keeping local teams unblocked, making well-informed design and scope tradeoffs within the broader product vision, and bringing US-based design, product, and business stakeholders in when direction, customer impact, or strategic choices need broader alignment.

A day in the life (Responsibilities) 

• Own design for your product area: Take your work from early discovery through shipped UI, connecting each workflow to the broader inventory platform vision.

• Prototype with AI: Use AI prototyping tools such as Replit, Magic Patterns, or Claude to build working, interactive prototypes with realistic data, so ideas can be tested with customers and engineers before the team commits to them. Use AI across the rest of your practice too, from synthesizing research to exploring concepts, validating outputs carefully and modeling responsible, secure use of AI for the team.

• Design AI-first workflows: Identify where AI can materially reduce customer effort, such as reading invoices, normalizing supplier and item data, and recommending catalog and accounting mappings. Design just as carefully for when it is unsure: how customers review low-confidence results, correct mistakes, and come to trust the system.

• Engage directly with customers: Research with retail and restaurant operators, and with the internal teams who support them, to understand their inventory needs, and translate those insights into design direction and testable ideas.

• Make complex data feel simple: Turn supplier catalogs, mappings, sync status, and errors into experiences that are clear, forgiving, and fast, on desktop and in the hand.

• Collaborate early and often: Partner closely with product managers and engineers in Chennai and the U.S., sharing work early, communicating design rationale clearly, and helping the team make good decisions quickly.

• Raise the craft bar: Deliver pixel-perfect UI, apply and extend the Toast design system with good judgment, and contribute to the quality of the wider Retail design practice.

title: Recruitment Business Partner
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Recruitment Business Partner to lead recruitment delivery for a portfolio of client accounts from our India delivery centre. You will lead a team of team leads and recruiters, partner with Sales and client hiring managers, and own the full hiring cycle from requirement to joining.

This is a delivery leadership role, not a desk-recruiting role. You will be measured on outcomes: how quickly strong candidates reach the client, how many are selected, and how many join. You will also act as a trusted advisor to Sales and clients, using market insight and data to shape realistic requirements, rates and timelines.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Delivery ownership

- Own monthly and quarterly hiring targets (selections and joiners) for the accounts in scope.

- Prioritise open requirements each week, and decide which to push, escalate or pause.

- Make sure quality profiles reach the client quickly, especially on priority roles.

- Track every requirement from intake to joining, and step in early when a role stalls, a candidate disengages or an offer is at risk.

Stakeholder management

- Lead intake and calibration discussions so every role has a clear brief, a realistic budget and an agreed interview process before sourcing starts.

- Agree feedback timelines with Sales and clients, and follow up with data when they slip.

- Advise Sales on which requirements are likely to close and where the team should focus.

People leadership

- Lead, coach and manage team leads and recruiters against clear weekly productivity goals.

- Run regular performance reviews, identify gaps early and put development plans in place.

- Hire, onboard and ramp up new recruiters, and develop future team leads.

Process and data

- Make sure the team follows the agreed recruitment process, with accurate and complete data in the applicant tracking system.

- Use dashboards and reports to find bottlenecks across the hiring funnel (submission → interview → selection → joining) and fix them.

- Keep offer and post-selection drop-outs low, and lead root-cause reviews when they rise.

Quality and candidate experience

- Raise screening quality so clients see fewer, better-matched profiles.

- Make sure every candidate receives timely updates and a clear outcome.

Sourcing channels

- Work closely with the central sourcing team on role allocation, handovers and turnaround time.

- Make effective use of job boards, referrals, vendor partners and internal talent pools.

Reporting

- Prepare monthly account and team performance reviews for leadership, with clear commentary on trends and actions.

HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED

- Selections and joiners against target

- Time to first qualified profiles on priority roles

- Submission-to-interview and interview-to-selection conversion

- Offer and post-selection drop-out rates

- Joiner retention in the first 30 days

- Team productivity and data quality

- Stakeholder satisfaction (Sales and client feedback)

WHAT YOU BRING

Must have

- 8-12 years in recruitment, with at least 3 years leading recruiters or team leads against delivery targets.

- A strong background in IT recruitment or staffing (contract, permanent or managed services), ideally for international clients.

- A proven record of meeting hiring targets, which you can back with your own numbers.

- Confidence with senior stakeholders: you run intake calls, challenge with evidence and handle escalations calmly.

- Strong analytical skills: comfortable with funnel metrics, Excel and BI dashboards.

- A coaching leadership style that balances accountability with development.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

Nice to have

- Experience with Global Capability Centres (GCC), offshore or captive delivery models.

- Experience working with European clients and across time zones.

- Experience integrating teams after a merger or acquisition.

- Experience managing recruitment vendors.

- Hands-on experience with ATS and CRM tools.

Dafür kombinieren wir unsere eigene Content Engine TextRocket mit einem Online-PR-Marktplatz mit über 100.000 Publishern. Deine Rolle Du verantwortest das SEO und die KI-Sichtbarkeit von getmentioned.com. Du entscheidest, welche Themen wir besetzen, welche Seiten wir bauen oder verbessern und was als Nächstes passiert. Daneben betreuen wir noch einige wenige SEO-Kunden, denen du bei Fragen und in der strategischen Beratung zur Seite stehst; der Aufwand dafür hält sich in Grenzen. Dein Impact Wir verkaufen Sichtbarkeit in Google und KI-Suchen. Jede Seite, die du nach vorn bringst, bringt Besucher und Anfragen. Und wenn ChatGPT nach dem besten Anbieter für Linkaufbau gefragt wird, soll die Antwort GetMentioned lauten. Deine Aufgaben Du legst fest, welche Suchbegriffe und Fragen wir besetzen, in Google und in KI-Suchen. Du planst die Themen, schreibst Briefings und eigene Texte und überarbeitest bestehende Seiten, mit unserer Content Engine TextRocket und KI. Wo es sinnvoll ist, steuerst du Freelancer. Du kümmerst dich um Onpage und Technik: interne Verlinkung, Seitenstruktur, Meta-Daten, strukturierte Daten, Indexierung und Ladezeit, gemeinsam mit unserem Entwicklungsteam. Du sorgst dafür, dass ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini und die AI Overviews GetMentioned nennen, wenn es um Backlinks, Brand Mentions und Digital PR geht. Du planst Links, Erwähnungen und Digital PR für die eigene Marke über unseren Marktplatz. Du beobachtest Search Console, Rankings und KI-Erwähnungen und weißt jede Woche, was sich bewegt hat und warum. Du beantwortest Fragen unserer wenigen SEO-Kunden

title: Account Manager - Southern Europe
description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company-from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

This is a builder’s role, where you'll own both the technical depth and commercial outcomes for some of ElevenLabs' most exciting customers across Southern Europe, sitting at the intersection of product, engineering, and revenue.

You'll get ahead of the problem. You'll dig into how customers deploy ElevenLabs across web, mobile, and their systems, spot the problems before they do, inspire new use-cases and own the solution end to end. You'll own the number too: renewals, expansion and cross-sell. Success here means driving real revenue retention and growth for your book of business.

What this looks like day to day

You'll run onboarding, enablement, and growth across ElevenLabs' full platform, core speech models, creative tools, and Agents. You'll advise customers on production deployment, not just theory, digging into usage and performance data to catch friction early and keep adoption moving.

You'll also own commercial outcomes for a defined book of business against clear targets: Gross Revenue Retention, Net Revenue Retention, cross-sell, and net expansion. You'll spot expansion opportunities early, own renewals and upsells end to end, and work closely with Sales, Engineering, and CS leadership to turn technical wins into revenue.

Requirements

- 5+ years of Customer Success, Account Management or Technical Account Ma

description:
Director of Marketing
Parsley Health · Marketing · Remote US, with a preference for Eastern or Central time zones and NYC metro · Full-time
About Parsley Health
Parsley Health is rebuilding primary care around root-cause, whole-person medicine. Our members get board-certified clinicians, health coaches, advanced testing, and a care platform that connects the dots across all of it.
We are a mostly virtual medical practice with care available across the country, and we recently expanded in-network access nationwide. As we grow, we are continuing to improve how we connect growth, care delivery, member experience, and financial performance so we can make better decisions and scale sustainably.
About the role
The Director of Marketing owns Parsley's full growth engine with the goal of acquiring more members efficiently. This is a high-visibility role in the driver's seat of Parsley's growth. Reporting to the SVP of Marketing, you'll run the channels that drive acquisition today and make sure brand investment shows up in conversion, CAC, and LTV.
We’re looking for a growth marketer with proven results, and with a strong track record of leveraging brand, trust, and storytelling lower acquisition cost and lift conversion, and who manages them accordingly.
What you’ll own
You'll lead a team of in-house specialists, agencies, and contractors to deliver on:

•
Growth channels: Own paid media (our primary channel), SEO, lifecycle, and affiliate. Set strategy, budget allocation, and testing priorities, and manage our paid media agency to CAC and payback targets.

•
Membership join flow and CRO: Partner with the Growth Product Manager on join-flow and site conversion, and align on a shared testing roadmap.

•
Brand, content, and PR: Partner with the Brand Manager on brand strategy and content, and with our PR agency on earned media, so all of it builds demand and trust that show up in conversion and CAC.

•
Measurement and planning: Own the marketing plan, budget, and forecast by channel. Define how the brand contributes to growth, report weekly on funnel performance, and make clear reallocation calls.

What we’re looking for

• 8+ years in growth marketing, with 3+ years leading a multi-channel team at a DTC, subscription, or consumer health company.

• Hands-on ownership of paid media budgets and agency management against CAC and payback targets.

• Direct experience scaling affiliate, SEO, and/or lifecycle/CRM.

• A track record of using brand, content, or PR to move growth metrics

• Strong data fluency, including using AI tools to self-serve and scale both campaigns and analytics.

• Comfortable being both strategist and operator on a lean team

• Healthcare, telehealth, or wellness experience preferred

• Experience marketing insurance-covered services preferred

• Experience partnering with a sales team on lead-to-purchase conversion

Compensation & Benefits
Parsley Health is committed to providing an equitable, fair, and transparent compensation program for all employees.
The starting salary for this role is between $160,000 and $190,000 , depending on skills and experience. We take a geo-neutral approach to compensation within the US, meaning that we pay based on job function and level, not location.
Individual compensation decisions are based on a number of factors, including experience level, skillset, scope, and internal equity relative to peers at the company.
Benefits include

• Equity stake for all employees based on role level

• Subsidized medical, dental, and vision insurance plan options

• Generous flexible time off plan

• Annual professional development stipend

• Annual wellness stipend

title: People Programs Lead
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year - far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

People Programs at Ramp builds the programs that shape how employees experience the company day to day; from someone's first week to the moments that define Ramp's culture company-wide. As Ramp scales, we need someone dedicated to building that function and taking our foundations to the next level.

In this role, you'll own programs like onboarding, manager enablement, engagement surveys, and the company-wide culture and recognition programs that shape how Ramp works, to name a few. You'll work closely with People Business Partners, People Operations, and Comms to make these programs land and thrive.

This work is high impact and high visibility. This is a hands-on, build-from-scratch role for someone with strong judgment who owns things fully.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build your own roadmap by pulling signal from engagement survey results, PBP and manager input, and People Ops, then make the call on what to build, improve, delegate, or stop.

- Own onboarding effectiveness - from pre-start through the first week - so every new hire's first experience of Ramp reflects how we work and our culture, partnering with People Ops and IT on day-to-day logistics

- Own the performance review cycle's program design - timeline, tools, and the manager/employee experience - partnering with PBPs on calibration and outcomes

- Build and own manager enablement as a standalone program: design the content, frameworks, and moments that help managers lead well, in partnership with PBPs on delivery

- Conceive, build, and run company-wide culture-building programs, fully owning logistics and content end-to-end

- Own recognition programming: how we surface and celebrate what's worth celebrating across the company and the rituals/milestones that make Ramp's culture tangible day to day

- Own the biannual engagement survey: design, run, and work with People Business Partners to translate results into action

- Be the trusted voice on what we should build in-house versus buy (tools, vendors, platforms) for people programs, grounded in judgment about what's worth the investment, not a default toward either

WHAT YOU NEED

- 5+ years owning people/culture programs end-to-end at a high-growth company - from ideation through hands-on execution

- A builder's track record: you've created programming that didn't exist before, not adapted someone else's playbook

- Strong facilitation and executive presence. You’re comfortable being the face of a program in front of the whole company, not just behind the scenes

- Comfortable with data: you can read engagement survey results and program metrics and turn them into a point of view, not just a report

- Proven ability to partner across functions (PBPs, Comms, Enablement, leadership)

- First-principles thinker who can turn ambiguity into a scalable framework: you don't need a rule book, but you can build one when it's missing

BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

- Flexible PTO

- Centralized home-office equipment ordering

- Health and wellness stipend
