title: Associate Director, Retail Media Search
description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships - all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open - we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com .

Role Summary & Impact

The Associate Director, Commerce Search will lead retail media search strategy and activation for a beauty-focused client portfolio, with an emphasis on navigating the unique commerce ecosystems of specialty retailers and department stores.

We’re looking for a commerce marketer who understands that retail media goes beyond Amazon and Walmart. The ideal candidate brings experience working with beauty, luxury, fashion, or similarly retail-driven brands and understands how brands engage consumers across retailers such as Ulta Beauty, Sephora, Macy’s, Nordstrom, Bloomingdale’s, and other specialty and department-store environments.

In this role, you’ll translate retailer, consumer, product, inventory, and performance insights into smart search and commerce activation strategies. You’ll lead campaign strategy and execution, develop keyword and optimization approaches, manage retail media investments, and partner directly with clients, retailers, and internal teams to drive measurable business results.

You’ll also manage and develop a team while helping clients navigate an increasingly complex retail media landscape. Strong retail media experience is essential; beauty or adjacent specialty retail experience is highly preferred.

What You’ll Do

• Lead search and retail media strategy and activation across multiple retailer environments.

• Own keyword strategy, campaign setup, bidding, budgeting, optimization, testing, and performance reporting.

• Bring a strong understanding of specialty and department-store commerce, particularly how brands drive growth across retailer partners.

• Translate retail considerations such as inventory, product availability, demand, profitability, promotions, and seasonality into media recommendations.

• Build strong relationships with client stakeholders, retailer media partners, and internal teams.

• Identify opportunities to connect retail search with the broader commerce and media ecosystem.

• Use performance data to identify trends and translate them into clear, actionable recommendations.

• Lead cross-channel testing and optimization strategies.

• Manage and develop direct reports, helping strengthen both their activation expertise and strategic capabilities.

• Stay ahead of developments across retail media platforms, ad products, technology, and measurement.

• Oversee campaign operations, including trafficking, billing/reconciliation, and data integrity.

Experience

• 5+ years of retail media, commerce search, paid ecommerce, or biddable performance media experience, with substantial hands-on retail search experience.

• Strongly preferred: experience supporting beauty, cosmetics, luxury, fashion, or another category heavily connected to specialty and department-store retail.

• Experience working with specialty retailers and/or department stores. Beauty retailer experience is especially relevant.

• Hands-on experience managing retail media/search campaigns and optimizing toward business and performance objectives.

• Experience across retail media and commerce platforms such as Amazon Ads, Criteo, Walmart Connect, Pacvue, and Skai, or comparable platforms.

• Strong understanding of how inventory, profitability, product availability, promotions, forecasting, and demand influence commerce media decisions.

title: Head of Growth, Marketplace (USA)
description:
About ISFY
iSellForYou is "the Uber of sales." We run a marketplace of remote sales reps across the United States. Our reps call real customers of ecommerce brands and help them finish the purchases they left behind. Brands get back revenue they would have lost. Reps earn commission on every sale they close, from home.

The role
We are looking for our Head of Growth to own the growth of our US rep marketplace. Your job is simple to say and fun to do: bring great sales reps into the marketplace, and turn sign-ups into active reps. You will build and run the full funnel, test fast, and measure everything.

What you will do
- Own the growth of the US rep marketplace, from first click to active rep
- Build and run recruiting funnels and campaigns, paid and organic: Meta, TikTok, Google and UGC creators
- Run SMS campaigns to opt-in lists only
- Improve the landing page and run conversion tests
- Build referral programs that turn our best reps into recruiters

Nice to have

Email with the subject "Application - Head of Growth". Include your name, phone number, LinkedIn profile, and a few lines about a growth campaign or funnel you built and what it achieved.

title: Equipment Finance Regional Sales Manager
description:
Job Summary
The Equipment Finance Regional Sales Manager is primarily responsible for identifying, delivering, and executing the equipment finance sales strategy. This position is expected to develop profitable relationships with both HomeTrust Bank clients and non-bank prospects either in footprint or out of footprint.
Key Responsibilities / Essential Functions

• Maintains a scheduled calling program with commercial clients and prospects to develop the equipment finance product and other bank services.

• Identifies and addresses areas of competition, as well as potential new markets in the assigned area that would maximize the volume and earnings of the equipment finance portfolio.

• Targets calling efforts towards both private and publicly owned companies with historically high annual capital expenditures (with annual revenues between $3 million and $100 million) and focuses on direct commercial end-users and financially stable vendors of good quality commercial equipment.

• Analyzes client and prospect financial data to effectively manage risk and provide complete and accurate credit applications to our credit underwriting partners.

• Attains or exceeds annual assigned budgets for volume, fees, and other key objectives, with an average of $300,000 per transaction.

• Works closely with the HomeTrust Bank Commercial Relationship Managers in all locations, conducts joint calls on clients and prospects, and sends viable referrals to Commercial Bankers and other key functional areas of the bank.

• Attends bank meetings to provide equipment finance product training.

• Structures, designs, and proposes viable equipment finance transactions.

• Works with clients to tailor agreements that meet customer needs from the beginning of the transaction to the close.

Job Requirements

Education:

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Operations Management, or related field.
Required:

• 8+ years of equipment financing and leasing experience.

• Experience in equipment financing product development, profitability, and pricing.

• Demonstrated competency with tax and accounting rules as they pertain to leasing, combined with current knowledge of tax law changes and their impact on potential clients.

• Demonstrated proficiency in basic computer applications, such as equipment finance systems.

• Ability to understand and embrace the core values of HomeTrust Bank .

• Ability to understand and use bank policies and procedures to ensure operational efficiency and regulatory compliance and to understand when an exception is required.

• Familiarity with all federal and state banking regulations pertaining to lending and consumer finance, including fair lending laws, the Bank Secrecy Act, and the US Patriot Act.

• Demonstrated problem solving ability and effective time management skills.

• Above average communications skills with emphasis on listening and problem-solving skills.

• Demonstrated ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and exceptional organization skills.

• Ability to prioritize duties and work independently.

• Ability to meet designated deadlines while remaining flexible to changing assignments.

• Self-motivated with excellent attention to detail.

• Proficient in Microsoft Office products.

Preferred:

• Previous experience with Commercial Finance Agreements (CFA), equipment loans, and all equipment lease documentation.

• Experience with property tax and sales tax for equipment leasing.

About HomeTrust Bank
HomeTrust Bank , founded in 1926, is a North Carolina chartered, community-focused financial institution committed to providing value-added community banking through online/mobile channels and multiple locations in Virginia, North Carolina, South Carolina, and Tennessee. Learn more at www.htb.com. Apply today to take your first steps towards joining this talented population of employees within a growing organization.
